svg.title: Terraform plan
svg.desc: 13 resources (13 cards), 6 relationships. Lines show architectural relationships. Edge titles identify the relationship kind and Terraform change. Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified. Spatial card role marks: rounded rectangle = execution; cylinder = data store; hexagon = network.
